summary: Agent workspace for research, analysis and coding that lets you pick from many AI models and connect your own data sources.

heroCommands.command: Open the web app at console.mindshub.ai, or download the macOS or Windows desktop app

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: MindsHub, from MindsDB, is an agent workspace for knowledge work and software development. It runs open-source agent harnesses with your choice of models, connects your data sources, and turns agent output into documents, dashboards, apps and code.
sixtySeconds.problem: Many agent tools lock you into one model provider. MindsHub lets you switch between frontier and open models in one place, with connected data and memory.
whoFor: Knowledge workers doing research and analysis
Developers using AI agents for code
Teams that want to self-host an agent workspace
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for model choice, a secure data vault, swappable open agent harnesses and flexible deployment from cloud to air-gapped.
requirements: A browser for the web app, or macOS / Windows for the desktop app

overview: Get started with the web app (sign in, nothing to install), the macOS .pkg or Windows .exe desktop app, or build from source on Linux.

Features include connected data (BigQuery, Postgres, Gmail, Drive, HubSpot, Notion, Linear) with credentials kept per connection, a model router across Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, Qwen and Kimi, open agents Anton and Hermes, artifacts you can publish, and memory, skills and scheduling.
It's free to start; Pro adds all frontier models and private artifacts. It can be deployed in cloud, VPC, on-prem, air-gapped or hybrid setups. The code is MIT licensed.
limitations: Pro plan needed for all frontier models
Linux has no ready desktop app
